entities.name: Abbad ibn Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abbad ibn Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr al-Asadi was a Tabi'un and a narrator of hadith, and a judge in Mecca when it was ruled by his father, Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr.
